scope.description: Promoted-leader variant on the captured snapshot: N=3 with Thrifty, the recovering replica has IsLeader true and a maxRecvBallot above its own ballot base, one peer holds the instance COMMITTED with a real command, and the recovering replica holds a default record for it.
assumptions: the recovering replica is the replica the master designated through Replica.BeTheLeader
a slow quorum (its own entry plus one reply) is sufficient to resolve
excluded: the non-promoted variant, which claim C1 covers
producing the committed record through a proposal round

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: harness-only scaffolding: two Replica values are constructed in-package, per-peer buffers replace the transport, and recovery is entered directly through startRecoveryForInstance; handlers are unmodified
variant: the recovering replica has IsLeader true and maxRecvBallot set above its ballot base, modelling the replica the master promoted after it had already seen traffic

plan_uncertainties: The harness prepares the peer's COMMITTED record directly; a full history is not constructed.
The outcome is observed for one instance and one recovery attempt; later Commit propagation to other replicas is not driven.
The third property observes the records the handlers hold after the broadcast; it does not execute the state machines, so the applied-state consequence is left open.
grounding_unresolved: the ballot history of a real promoted replica is modelled as a single maxRecvBallot value
the real ballot history is modelled as one maxRecvBallot value
